description: Flow Comment LINKED to the step it comments on. The ICommentNode was already being born through the comments key of the logic op, but loose: nothing created the ICommentConnector, which is the most used type of the trio in the real world (3054 instances in 31 of the 44 modules of the census, always with Source and Target defined and Label never). The link only started to work after the kernel chose the CreateConnector overload by the TYPE OF THE TARGET: the concrete class Comment implements five areas of the model (Logic.Nodes, UI.Web, UI.Mobile, Processes, BusinessProcesses) and exposes one overload per area, and the order of Type.GetInterfaces() is not guaranteed by the CLR -- with whichever came first, the link died saying that the connector does not exist. The direction is necessarily comment -> node: the Comment does not accept an incoming link from an ordinary node.
